source_refs.note: Topic 7.1.1 Importance (PDF 176-177, printed 173-174). Short question 1 is answered.

items: Protection of rights: terms define rights such as privacy, a level of service and redress; a food-delivery service such as Foodpanda says what happens if an order is wrong or late.

Clarity and transparency: users know what the service delivers, on what conditions and what is not allowed; a mobile payment service states transaction limits, fees and how to report unauthorized transactions.
Legal safeguards: businesses are protected from misuse; an online education platform can forbid sharing course content without permission.

blocks.text: Some platforms update their terms often, so review them from time to time (Tip).
